verses.pali: Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho āyasmā rādho bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: Seated to one side, Venerable Rādha said to the Buddha:
“Sir, they speak of a ‘liability to fall’.
What has a liability to fall?”

verses.pali: “Rūpaṁ kho, rādha, vayadhammo, vedanā vayadhammo, saññā vayadhammo, saṅkhārā vayadhammo, viññāṇaṁ vayadhammo.
verses.english: “Rādha, form, feeling, perception, choices, and consciousness have a liability to fall.
They understand: ‘… there is nothing further for this place.’”
